error[ZC-E0818]: a TLS peer needs something zcube does not offer
  cause  the server answered with a HelloRetryRequest; zcube offers one key
         share and no retry
  fix    Connect to a zcube server: zcube offers no other TLS settings.
  more   zcube explain E0818 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0818.html
